name: Uchimura Yuusuke
source:
The protagonist of this story, a first-year student at the academy. He possesses a reasonable sense of justice and conscience, but is an introverted and powerless boy against violence-a very ordinary boy. He's good at studying but bad at sports, and doesn't have any close friends. He has a low opinion of himself, which further exacerbates his introverted personality. His father works at a factory affiliated with Mutoh Heavy Industries.
